graphics_stack_comparison_20261118.classification: Treat the desktop freezes and unexpected restarts as one incident family while investigating the shared graphics stack. Platform power handling can change how the console recovers.

triggers: Warcraft III x86 D3D9 window creation
PAL4 archive extraction before the game process existed
local_lite.last_unpaced_video: Five NV12 frames matched, four Present calls returned and the next Present began before the reboot.
local_lite.records: Multiple Kernel-Power 41 events with BugcheckCode 0. The user saw automatic restarts.
local_lite.wifi: The user recalls a crash with Wi-Fi switched off. The test method and matching event record are unavailable.

external_oled.graphics: The author integrated mesa-switch-woa WDDM and tgd3d/NVK on Mariko OLED.
external_oled.platform: Windows inbox sdbus behind an EL2 SDMMC trap, SwitchWifi from the shared driver project, and a separate swbatt GPU power bridge. The Lite platform inventory includes switchfan, switchpwrbtn and switchbattery.
external_oled.recovery: The OLED author used a long power-button press after the hang. The Lite user attributes the different recovery behavior to the platform power drivers.
external_oled.startup_trials: Three of five ordinary transitions hung. In five trials with other shell GPU clients delayed for ten seconds, all five remained up thirty seconds after those clients resumed.
external_oled.trace_tail: In two early hangs DWM presented four frames, Explorer created its own device, and both clients submitted work. KMD recorded successful preemption requests through the trace tail. No recovery request or reset was captured.
external_oled.longer_session: A separate KMD 0.1.0.203 session hung after about ten minutes of browser and Explorer use.

discriminating_measurements: Confirm the DWM rendering backend before the workload. Compare the same archive workload on Basic Display and the GPU desktop under the same power and Wi-Fi conditions.
Correlate per-client submission, hardware progress, fence retirement, preemption completion and recovery with the first missing progress. Record reset source separately.
graphics_stack_comparison_20261118.root_cause: Unknown. The traces justify prioritizing the shared graphics path, particularly overlapping work from separate GPU clients.

windowed_d3d11_startup_20261118.observation: The first x64 DXVK windowed teapot control loaded application-local DXGI and D3D11. D3D11 hardware device creation returned E_FAIL (0x80004005). No adapter identity or rendered frame was recorded. Only the baseline trial directory and PID were recorded. The candidate measurement never started.
windowed_d3d11_startup_20261118.scope: This is a separate non-PAL4 startup failure. The observed device creation error does not identify the reset source.

subsequent_loader_control.effect: The calibration initially used an executable path missing from the application driver list. Explicitly registering the two test paths allowed enumeration and restored D3D11 device creation on the accepted baseline.

file_integrity_at_restart_20261118.result: All nine invalid cache payloads in three unexpected-restart sessions were entirely zero-filled. All 53 cache files in two application-exit controls passed BLAKE3 verification. The initiating fault is still unknown.

teapot_and_subsequent_logon_20261118.first_scope: Both executables rendered the same scenes. The candidate printed every timing sample after both window checks. Its normal-exit marker was absent after the reset. Write loss prevents assigning the reset to a specific destructor.

following_boot.source: The untriggered test jobs did not restart with Windows. The accepted login controller recorded entry to native activation and did not record its completion. The next boot disabled that controller and used Basic Display.

recovery.input_sources: Windows Kernel-Power event 105 (AcOnline) and the SwitchBattery charge controller status. On this build the charger reports external power when REG08 VBUS_STAT is 1 or 2 and the power-good bit is set.

retry.controller_invocation: The accepted activation controller was invoked once with -Retry. PowerShell line breakpoints recorded its milestones to a write-through journal. No GPU program was launched during the retry.

recovery.interpretation: The later logged-in desktop activation and its 30-second dwell completed on external power, on the same Windows boot that previously held the native GPU at Code 43. Both battery and externally powered resets have been observed in different workloads. These trials do not isolate a power component or identify the cause.

single_pair_timing.scope: These are single 96-iteration runs in the recorded order. The draw and Present times end when the API returns. The candidate had slower mean and P95 in this pair, and its normal exit could not be verified. The candidate was set aside. The accepted WSI source remained in use.

accepted_driver_teardown_control.measurement: RAII markers recorded completion of the normal COM release order, window destruction and return from main. Each transition flushed the application journal to disk. Parent observation confirmed process exit. The time between final window verification and frame report includes writing 96 timing lines.

nvdec_default_device_creation_20261118.status: Recorded with the existing load-transition incidents. The operator suspects a shared cause and requested that investigation start with synchronization when a D3D11.1 device skips the Windows runtime submission queue. Causality remains open.

candidate.capture: DXGI found GM20B. Host logging ended during D3D11VA device creation, before the fixture reported opening the sample or submitting a decoded frame. The operator had no screen observation for this paired trial. Network loss leaves its postincident boot state unknown.

nvdec_default_device_creation_20261118.earlier_candidate_attempts: Three earlier candidate trials were followed by distinct Windows boots with Event 41 and bugcheck zero. One launcher contained a verified pre-FFmpeg PowerShell error. No new watchdog dump identified their cause.

prior_pal4_windows_queue.event: tgd3d event 22, DWM process, stage 3, HRESULT S_OK. Each count is an accepted submission callback. Completion and resource retirement require separate evidence.

sync_questions: For each producer and DWM device, establish its negotiated DDI and whether NVK takes the runtime queue.
Check the ingress and completion fence identities, values, GPU waits and ownership of displayed allocations across the two submission paths. Verify completion before resource and context retirement.
nvdec_default_device_creation_20261118.driver_scope: The paired UMDs share the same frozen device-construction and teardown code. Of 25 linked UMD object files, only tgd3d_video.cpp.obj changed in the default-discovery candidate. The daily reference remains the previously accepted UMD.
